limitations: This is a small authored lexical sanity suite with many deliberately clear negatives. It cannot establish learner difficulty or statistical superiority; review actual top-neighbor lists alongside it.
The eight query sets contain incomplete positive-neighbor labels. Report hit/recall at 5; do not count unlisted neighbors as errors.
Report triplet results by group as well as overall, because the bank is heavily numerical. Raw cosine margins are not directly comparable across models.

The sense examples reflect the intended card meanings but do not directly contrast two meanings of the same written surface. The approved bank lacks enough separately identified same-surface senses for that test.
Semantic quality and picture validity are separate. Staged issue-79 never-compete groups remain diagnostics and must not be activated silently by this benchmark.
Partially overlapping number/character controls remain unscored diagnostics: 三人 versus 二人/三角, 四千 versus 二百/四角, 千円 versus お金/千, and 三日月 versus 月光/三人.
